subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Miscellaneous runtime object and helper infrastructure: a large family of empty no-op stub routines (nullsub / EmptyStub / NoOpStub) occupying callback or dispatch slots; trivial constant-returning and identity/pass-through shims; heterogeneous byte-field accumulator helpers that add a byte/char into a caller-supplied object field; byte-increment forwarders that mutate a byte and then delegate to another routine; indexed 8-byte-strided dword-slot mutators that write/subtract/OR a slot and tail-call an initializer; small field accessors, read/write helpers and setters over fixed displacements; thin single-call wrappers forwarding to routines named only in raw source; a guarded one-time-initialization delegate; a hex-string parser used by the material shader reaction-effect path; a 2D box-filter image processor; and a family of unconditional JUMPOUT tail-jump thunks whose targets lie outside the packet.

summary: GUESS grouping of 61 validated functions in the generic_runtime_objects scope. Every owner is UNKNOWN in the packet; class boundaries are defensible functional groupings, not attested source layout. Twenty empty-body stubs (nullsub_93/94/95/96/97/99/100/101/102/104/130/131/199/200/201, EmptyStub_0000/EmptyStub, EmptyFunction, NoOpStub x2) form RuntimeStubSlot. Five constant-returning leaves (return 1/1/5/1/0) form TrivialConstantReturn; three identity/pass-through shims (return this / this / second argument) form IdentityPassThrough. Nine byte-level accumulators share a byte-add-into-field shape (ByteFieldAccumulator); two combine a byte increment with a forward call (ByteIncrementForwarder); three mutate an 8-byte-strided dword slot and tail-call an initializer (StridedSlotMutator); one writes four consecutive dword slots (DwordSlotBulkWriter). Small accessor/setter helpers cover ObjectFieldAccessor (this+0xE8), FieldReadWriteHelper (a3+0x64 read plus two out-slots) and PointerFieldSetter (*a4 = a3, return a4). Six thin wrappers each perform a single call to a routine named only in raw source (StringCopyWithBufferRealloc, FileSettingExistenceCheck, memset32, DoubleBufferFree, CallbackRegistration_8ce0, loc_4FF715+2) and form SingleCallWrapper. GuardedInitDelegate (0x004C7C10) delegates to a one-time initializer only when its argument equals 1 and is invoked by InitWithStatusCheck (0x004C82C0); HexStringParser (0x004CAD30) is a back-to-front hex parser used by MaterialShaderReactionEffectParser (0x004CA480); BoxFilterImageProcessor (0x0050368A) implements a 2x2 box filter over a packed 32-bit pixel buffer. Six JUMPOUT thunks (0x0051ECE0, 0x0051EDA0, 0x0051EE70, 0x0051EF50, 0x0051F0B0, 0x0051F7C0) transfer control to targets outside the packet. Notable decompiler-artifact hazards: huge decimal constants (1070395196, 1566442692, 963967804) and negative register-relative field offsets (a1-61, a1-1, a2-125) appear in the raw source under 'positive sp value' warnings and are not interpreted as valid object offsets.

function_roles.role: Empty __stdcall stub accepting one integer argument and performing no operations; returns immediately. Likely a placeholder or intentionally disabled callback; caller and argument meaning unevidenced.
Thiscall accessor returning char* this + 232 (0xE8); no dereference occurs, exposing an embedded sub-object or buffer at a fixed displacement. Object type and pointed-to data unknown.

Adds char a1 to the byte at a2 + 94 (0x5E), then returns the HGDIOBJ produced by GetStockObject((unsigned __int16)__ES__). Byte-increment shape plus legacy GDI-focus ABI name suggest font bitmap byte update, unverified; a3..a12 declared but unused.

Field read/write helper: stores a1 into the dword pointed by a2, reads the dword at a3 + 100 (0x64), stores it into the dword pointed by a5, and returns it. Legacy Vtable_Field_Getter ABI lead unverified; a4 unused.
Empty stub (nullsub_94): no parameters, no calls, no field/global accesses, no recorded callers.
Empty stub (nullsub_95): no parameters, no calls, no field/global accesses, no recorded callers.

Userpurge byte accumulator: adds the byte value `result` (AL) to the byte at address (a2 - 1070395196) and returns `result` unchanged. Constant preserved verbatim from positive-sp-flagged decompilation; not interpreted.
Adds byte a1 to the byte at a2 + 51 (0x33); returns 0 unconditionally. a3/a4 unused by the body.
Bulk initializer: writes the same int value into four consecutive dword slots a2[20], a2[21], a2[22], a2[23] (offsets 0x50-0x5C) and returns that value.
Empty function stub (EmptyStub_0000) with a void body containing no statements; no fields, globals, guards or callees. Placeholder, alignment pad, or out-of-line no-op.
Empty stub (nullsub_199): no body, no parameters observed, no calls, no field/global accesses, no recorded callers.

__usercall helper (StructByteCounterIncrement): treats ecx argument a1 as a base and adds a2 to the byte at a1 - 61. Counter 61 bytes below the base is an unusual register-relative artifact; owning struct layout unknown.
Empty stub (nullsub_96): no body, no parameters observed, no calls, no field/global accesses, no recorded callers.
Leaf function (AlwaysReturnTrue) taking no arguments, reading no state, returning the constant 1 unconditionally. Semantic meaning of the constant (boolean true, count, id) unknown.
__stdcall leaf (AlwaysReturnTrueIgnoreArg) accepting one argument a1 but never reading it; returns the constant 1 unconditionally.
Empty stub (EmptyStub) with a void body and no parameters; legacy ABI label Empty_Stub_4a40b0 confirms no-op intent. Whether the original ever performed work is unknown.
Empty stub (nullsub_200): raw body contains only a null statement; performs no work when called.
Byte-field modifier (ByteModifier): a1 in ecx, a2 in bl; adds byte a2 to the byte at a1 - 61. Negative register-relative offset is a decompiler artifact; owning class unknown.

Forwarding helper (sub_4B19CA): writes dword a1 into byte address a2 + 8*a3 - 1, then calls sub_4B19D0(a1) and returns its result. Minus-one adjustment makes the slot potentially unaligned; slot layout unproven.
__usercall helper (a1 in ecx, a2 in ebp, a3 in esi): subtracts a1 from the dword at slot address a2 + 8*a3 - 1, then tail-calls VTableInitWithDefaults_1a30(a1) and propagates its result.
__usercall helper (a1 in ecx, a2 in ebp, a3 in esi): ORs a1 into the dword at slot address a2 + 8*a3 - 1, then tail-calls InitWithSentinelPattern(a1) and propagates its result.
Empty stub (nullsub_97): no body, no parameters observed, no calls, no field/global accesses, no recorded callers.
__thiscall identity thunk (ReturnThis) returning the receiver this pointer unchanged; single bare return, no state read or modified.
Null-stub (EmptyFunction, nullsub_98): no-argument void function with an empty body; implicit bare return, no side effects.
Trivial __stdcall passthrough (StringCopyReallocWrapper): forwards a1 to StringCopyWithBufferRealloc and returns the callee's integer result unchanged.

Zero-argument single-call wrapper (FileSettingExistenceCheckWrapper) invoking FileSettingExistenceCheck() and returning its boolean result; only recorded caller is GameExit (0x0042DB20), suggesting an exit-path file-setting presence check.

__usercall helper (Memset32WrapperWithByteAccumulator): adds char a3 to the byte at a2 + 10 (0x0A), calls memset32(a4, result, a2), and returns result unchanged. Positive-sp warning; a2 used both as object base and as memset byte count is likely a register-overlap artifact.
Empty stdcall stub (nullsub_99) taking two integer arguments and performing no operations; likely a replaced no-op or reserved callback slot.
Empty no-op stub (nullsub_100) accepting a single integer parameter a1 but reading or writing nothing.
Empty no-op stub (nullsub_101) taking no arguments; body performs no operations.
int __fastcall passthrough (ReturnSecondArgument) ignoring its first argument a1 and returning its second argument a2 unchanged; no state access.

Corrupted function (corruptedByteAddStub, positive-sp flagged): appears to add result (al) to the byte at address a2 + 1566442692 and return result unchanged; the huge constant is not a valid object offset and the region may be misdecoded data.
Trivial constant function (returnConstant5) returning the integer constant 5 with no arguments, side effects, or guards; called by SetupCarLightingAndRender (0x004C71C0).

Guarded delegation (conditionalDelegateToInitializer): initializes result to 0, and only when the this/parameter equals 1 delegates to OneTimeInitializationWithAtexitStyleRegistration and returns its value; otherwise returns null. Called by InitWithStatusCheck (0x004C82C0).
Empty no-op stub (nullsub_102) taking one int argument under __stdcall; no body.

Hex-string parser (HexStringParser): reads a hex digit string from the last character backwards, accumulating each valid nibble (0-9, a-f, A-F) as v8 << (4 * nibble_index); any non-hex character aborts with the partial result. Declared __thiscall but behaves as a free function; called by MaterialShaderReactionEffectParser (0x004CA480).
Empty no-op stub (nullsub_201) taking no arguments; no observable effect.
Empty no-op stub (NoOpStub, nullsub_103): empty body, performs no work, touches no memory.

Thunk (ByteIncrementJumpThunk, legacy name Thunk_with_Byte_Increment_Jump): increments the byte at a1 - 1 by char a2, then tail-calls loc_4D879C thiscall with a3 and returns its result; positive-sp warning and register layout suggest a hand-written thunk.
Trivial constant-returning stub (ReturnConstantOne): no arguments, returns integer constant 1 immediately.

Byte increment on struct (ByteIncrementOnStructPARTIAL): adds char result to the byte at (a2 - 963967804) and returns result unchanged through al; constant preserved verbatim, positive-sp-flagged PARTIAL reconstruction.
Empty stub (NullSub_130): decompiled body contains no statements; performs no observable work, returns void.
Empty stub (NullSub_131): decompiled body contains no statements; performs no observable work, returns void.
Byte accumulator helper (ByteAccumAddWithReturn): adds the low byte of a1 to the byte at a2 + 94 (0x5E), then returns a1 unchanged; operates purely on caller registers.

Forwarder (ThunkWithByteIncrementForward): adds a1 to the byte at a2 - 125, then forwards a3 to ConditionalResourceRelease and returns that call's result; negative offset is a register-derived artifact.
Trivial byte helper (CharAdd): returns the char sum of two caller-supplied byte arguments (a1 in al, a2 in ch); no globals, callees, fields or control flow.
This-call thunk (ThunkToFUN004f83b0) forwarding its `this` argument unchanged to DoubleBufferFree and returning the callee's int result; thunk itself adds no logic.
Zero-argument jump thunk (j_CallbackRegistration_8ce0, IDA j_ prefix) forwarding to CallbackRegistration_8ce0 and returning its int result.

Parameter-reorder tailcall wrapper (ParameterReorderWrapper): tail-calls the stdcall target at loc_4FF715 + 2 with (a3, a2, a1, v6), reordering incoming parameters and passing the uninitialized stack slot v6 as the fourth argument; positive-sp warning makes the stack layout unreliable.
__thiscall identity (identity) returning its this pointer unchanged; raw source is only 'return this;'.

C-level 2D box filter (F_2DImageBoxFilter) over a packed 32-bit pixel buffer: a row/column double loop averages each 2x2 neighborhood (four dword taps at offsets 0, +4, +row-stride, +row-stride+4) under the 0xFF00 and 0xFF00FF channel masks with additive rounding, re-masks with 0x3FC00 / 0x3FC03FC, shifts right by 2 and stores; output row span advances by a6 bytes while the input row span advances by 2*a5 dwords (half-span downsample). Returns 0.
Empty __stdcall stub (nullsub_104) taking three arguments, none referenced; no body, returns immediately.
Trivial stub (ReturnZeroStub) whose entire body is an unconditional return of the integer constant 0; no parameters, fields, globals, calls, or guards.
Minimal four-argument setter (SetterReturnA4): stores a3 into the dword pointed by a4 and returns the a4 pointer unchanged; a1 and a2 unused by the body.
Null stub (NoOpStub) with an empty body; no parameters, fields, globals, guards, or callees; implicit void return.
Unconditional JUMPOUT thunk (JumpOutThunk51ECE0): single tail-jump to 0x51ECF1 with arguments a1/a2/a3 passed through; target body lies outside this packet.
Jump thunk (JumpThunkTo51EDB1): unconditional JUMPOUT to 0x51EDB1, forwarding __stdcall arguments a1/a2 unchanged.
Jump thunk (JumpThunkTo51EE81): unconditional JUMPOUT to 0x51EE81, forwarding __stdcall arguments a1/a2 unchanged.
Jump thunk (JumpThunkTo51EF61): unconditional JUMPOUT to 0x51EF61, forwarding __stdcall arguments a1/a2/a3 unchanged.
Unconditional forward-jump thunk (sub_51F0B0): single JUMPOUT(0x51F0C1) under a four-argument __stdcall signature; arguments forwarded untouched.
Unconditional forward-jump thunk (sub_51F7C0): single JUMPOUT(0x51F7D1) under a one-argument __stdcall signature; argument forwarded untouched.

classes.name: RuntimeStubSlot
classes.responsibility: Family of empty/no-op stub routines (nullsub_93/94/95/96/97/99/100/101/102/104/130/131/199/200/201, EmptyStub_0000, EmptyStub, EmptyFunction, NoOpStub x2) with empty or null-statement bodies. None touch state, parameters, globals, or callees; several declare arguments that are never read. Likely placeholder, callback-slot, or intentionally disabled routines; whether some addresses are disassembly artifacts (data misidentified as code) is unconfirmed.

classes.name: TrivialConstantReturn
classes.responsibility: Leaf routines that return a fixed integer constant (1, 5, 1, 1, 0) with no parameters read, no state access, and no calls; one member (0x004C7C00, returns 5) is invoked by the car-lighting render path SetupCarLightingAndRender. The semantic meaning of each constant (boolean, flag, count, id) is unevidenced.

classes.name: IdentityPassThrough
classes.responsibility: Trivial shims that return an incoming value unchanged: the __thiscall receiver (this) or the second argument of a fastcall signature. No reads, writes, or calls; typical uses include identity getters, virtual-override stubs, or forwarding targets, none attested by this packet.

classes.name: ByteFieldAccumulator
classes.responsibility: Heterogeneous byte-arithmetic helpers (grouped by shape, not by proven common class) that add a byte/char value into a byte field of a caller-supplied object, several returning the input value unchanged. Field displacements are mostly positive (a2+51, a2+94); several members (0x0049C486, 0x004C4BA8, 0x004DB546) carry huge decimal constants and positive-sp warnings, and two (0x004A0248, 0x004A4108) target a1-61, all treated as decompiler artifacts whose true targets are unknown. One member (0x00494C15) pairs the byte add with a GetStockObject call under a legacy GDI ABI name; one (0x004F1B04) is a pure char add with no memory access.

classes.name: ByteIncrementForwarder
classes.responsibility: Thunks that mutate a byte near the start of a caller-supplied object (increment by a byte argument at negative register-relative offsets a1-1 / a2-125, likely decompiler artifacts) and then forward control to another routine, returning that routine's result. The forward targets (loc_4D879C, ConditionalResourceRelease) are not present as callee evidence in the packet.

classes.name: DwordSlotBulkWriter
classes.responsibility: Compact bulk-initializer writing one integer value into four consecutive dword slots (offsets 0x50-0x5C, i.e. array indices 20-23) of a caller-supplied object/array and returning the written value.

classes.name: StridedSlotMutator
classes.responsibility: Indexed-slot mutators over a caller-supplied base with an 8-byte element stride (address expression a2 + 8*a3 - 1, the trailing minus-one being an unproven alignment artifact). Each mutates the dword slot (write, subtract, or bitwise-OR) and then tail-calls an initializer named only in the raw source (sub_4B19D0, VTableInitWithDefaults_1a30, InitWithSentinelPattern), propagating its result.

classes.name: ObjectFieldAccessor
classes.responsibility: Thiscall accessor exposing an embedded sub-object or buffer at a fixed displacement: returns char* this + 232 (0xE8) without dereferencing. The pointed-to type and the caller's intended read are unestablished.

classes.name: FieldReadWriteHelper
classes.responsibility: Named-input/out-param helper: stores an incoming value (a1) into an out slot (a2), reads a dword field from a3 + 100 (0x64), stores it into another out slot (a5), and returns it. Legacy Vtable_Field_Getter ABI lead is unverified; a4 is unused.

classes.name: PointerFieldSetter
classes.responsibility: Minimal setter storing a value (a3) into a caller-supplied destination dword (a4) and returning the destination pointer unchanged; prototype arguments a1/a2 are unused. Which structure field a4 addresses is unevidenced.

classes.name: SingleCallWrapper
classes.responsibility: Thin wrappers whose entire behavior is a single call or tail-call to a routine named in the raw source, returning the callee's result unchanged. Targets (StringCopyWithBufferRealloc, FileSettingExistenceCheck, memset32, DoubleBufferFree, CallbackRegistration_8ce0, loc_4FF715+2) have no callee-address evidence in this packet. One member (0x004BBEC4) additionally accumulates a byte into offset +10 (0x0A) before its memset call under a positive-sp warning; one (0x00500161) reorders parameters for its tail-call target under an uninitialized stack slot.

classes.name: GuardedInitDelegate
classes.responsibility: Guarded delegation routine: initializes its result to null, and only when the this/parameter equals 1 delegates to a one-time-initialization routine (OneTimeInitializationWithAtexitStyleRegistration, named in source only); otherwise returns null. The comparison against (void*)1 suggests the argument is a flag or call-state rather than an object pointer. Called by InitWithStatusCheck (0x004C82C0).

classes.name: HexStringParser
classes.responsibility: Utility parser converting a hexadecimal digit string into an integer by walking the string from its last character and accumulating each nibble into its positional slot (v8 << (4 * nibble_index)); any non-hex character aborts with the partial result. Declared __thiscall but never references the receiver, so it behaves as a free function. Used by the material shader reaction-effect parser path (0x004CA480).

classes.name: JumpThunk
classes.responsibility: Unconditional JUMPOUT tail-jump thunks that transfer control to an absolute target address (0x51ECF1, 0x51EDB1, 0x51EE81, 0x51EF61, 0x51F0C1, 0x51F7D1) forwarding their __stdcall arguments unchanged; no local logic. The targets are not recorded as callees, so the real behavior lives outside this packet.

classes.name: BoxFilterImageProcessor
classes.responsibility: Image-processing routine implementing a 2D box filter over a packed 32-bit pixel buffer: a row/column double loop averages each 2x2 neighborhood (four dword taps under the 0xFF00 / 0xFF00FF channel masks) with additive rounding and a >>2 shift, and writes the result with an output row span about half the input span (2x2 downsample). The pixel-format split is inferred from the masks, not proven; no callers are recorded.

interfaces.name: SingleCallForwarder
interfaces.purpose: Thin wrapper that performs exactly one call to an internal routine and returns the callee's result unchanged; the callee is referenced by name only in the raw source and has no address evidence in this packet.

interfaces.name: TailJumpForwarder
interfaces.purpose: Unconditional JUMPOUT thunk transferring control to an absolute target address and forwarding all __stdcall arguments unchanged; the target bodies lie outside the packet, so each thunk's observable contract is limited to argument pass-through.

compatibility_contracts.name: ExitPathFileSettingCheck
compatibility_contracts.description: The GameExit path (0x0042DB20) invokes a zero-argument wrapper (0x004BA770) that calls FileSettingExistenceCheck() and returns its boolean result unchanged; a replacement exit path must preserve this file-setting presence check on game exit.

compatibility_contracts.name: CarLightingConstantQuery
compatibility_contracts.description: SetupCarLightingAndRender (0x004C71C0) invokes a zero-argument routine (0x004C7C00) that returns the constant integer 5; a replacement rendering path that consumes this query must preserve the constant value.

compatibility_contracts.name: ConditionalOneTimeInit
compatibility_contracts.description: InitWithStatusCheck (0x004C82C0) invokes a guarded routine (0x004C7C10) that, only when its argument equals 1, performs a one-time initialization and returns its result; otherwise it returns null. The delegated routine (OneTimeInitializationWithAtexitStyleRegistration) is named in source only and has no address evidence.

compatibility_contracts.name: HexStringParseContract
compatibility_contracts.description: MaterialShaderReactionEffectParser (0x004CA480) relies on a hex-string-to-int parser (0x004CAD30) that reads hex digits back-to-front and aborts with the partial result on any non-hex character; a replacement must reproduce this parse semantics.

compatibility_contracts.name: ByteAccumulatorAt0x5E
compatibility_contracts.description: Two byte-accumulator helpers (0x00494C15, 0x004DCD06) each read-modify-write a byte at displacement +94 (0x5E) of their caller-supplied object pointer; whether both refer to the same object type is not proven, but each requires a mutable byte at +94.

compatibility_contracts.name: PixelBufferBoxFilter
compatibility_contracts.description: A 2D box filter (0x0050368A) averages each 2x2 neighborhood of a packed 32-bit pixel buffer under the 0xFF00 / 0xFF00FF channel masks with rounding and a >>2 shift, writing to an output whose row span is about half the input row span; a replacement image path must preserve this downsampling and channel-mask arithmetic to keep output pixels identical.

unresolved: All 61 functions have UNKNOWN owners in the packet; the fifteen class groupings above are defensible functional groupings (GUESS), not attested source layout, and equal byte displacements on unrelated register-derived bases (e.g. +94 on a2 in 0x00494C15 vs 0x004DCD06) are not proven to be the same object.

Byte accumulator huge-constant members (0x0049C486 constant 1070395196, 0x004C4BA8 constant 1566442692, 0x004DB546 constant 963967804): the constants are preserved verbatim from 'positive sp value has been detected, the output may be wrong!' decompilation and are not valid object offsets; the true target addresses and the semantics of the byte accumulation are unrecoverable from this packet.

Negative register-relative field offsets (a1-61 in 0x004A0248 / 0x004A4108, a1-1 in 0x004D82C4, a2-125 in 0x004E0D68) place the mutated byte before the base pointer, which is unusual; these are treated as decompiler artifacts and the owning struct layouts are unknown.

GDIFontByteUpdate (0x00494C15): the __ES__ segment-register value feeding GetStockObject is a decompiler artifact and its intended stock-object argument is unknown; arguments a3 through a12 are declared but unused; the legacy GDI_font_byte_update ABI name has no independent evidence in this packet.

StridedSlotMutator (0x004B19CA, 0x004B1A2A, 0x004B1A4A): the callees sub_4B19D0, VTableInitWithDefaults_1a30 and InitWithSentinelPattern are referenced only by name with no address evidence; the 8-byte stride with a trailing minus-one-byte adjustment is unproven; whether the mutators are method entries, callbacks, or vtable thunks is undetermined.

SingleCallWrapper targets (StringCopyWithBufferRealloc, FileSettingExistenceCheck, memset32, DoubleBufferFree, CallbackRegistration_8ce0, loc_4FF715+2) are named in the raw source but have no callee-address evidence in this packet; their locations and exact contracts cannot be grounded here.

Memset32WrapperWithByteAccumulator (0x004BBEC4): a2 is used both as the base of the byte accumulator (+10) and as the byte count for memset32, likely a register-overlap artifact under the positive-sp warning; no callers are recorded.

ParameterReorderWrapper (0x00500161): v6 is an uninitialized stack slot passed as the fourth argument, and the tail-call target loc_4FF715 + 2 has no callee evidence; the parameter layout and the reason for the reordering are uncertain.

BoxFilterImageProcessor (0x0050368A): the pixel-format split implied by the 0xFF00 / 0xFF00FF masks and the half-span output-buffer contract are inferred from the arithmetic, not stated by the packet; parameter units (a3 dword span, a5 vertical stride, a6 output byte pitch) are DERIVED; no callers are recorded.

JumpThunk family (0x0051ECE0, 0x0051EDA0, 0x0051EE70, 0x0051EF50, 0x0051F0B0, 0x0051F7C0): targets (0x51ECF1, 0x51EDB1, 0x51EE81, 0x51EF61, 0x51F0C1, 0x51F7D1) are outside the packet; whether these are jump-table entries, tail-call shims, or packed stubs is unknown.

IdentityPassThrough members (0x004B1BAD, 0x004C29EC, 0x005007EC) and PointerFieldSetter (0x0051C086): no callers are recorded, so whether these are genuine forwarding/identity shims or unfinished placeholders is unconfirmed; a1/a2 unused in 0x0051C086.
VtableFieldGetter (0x0049A102): the legacy Vtable_Field_Getter ABI lead is unverified by any other packet evidence; a4 is declared but never used.

ConditionalDelegateToInitializer (0x004C7C10): the this == (void*)1 comparison against a thiscall parameter is atypical; the argument may be a flag or call-state rather than an object pointer, and OneTimeInitializationWithAtexitStyleRegistration has no callee address record.

The ABI-named legacy labels (GDIFontByteUpdate, VtableFieldGetter, ByteAccumulator, StructByteCounterIncrement, ByteModifier, SetterReturnA4, Single_Call_Wrapper_4b9fa0, Thunk_with_Byte_Increment_Jump, Parameter_Reorder_Wrapper) carry LEGACY trust and do not, on their own, establish caller contracts or owning classes.

Whether the stub addresses (e.g. 0x004A0000, 0x004A40B0, 0x004C4BA8) are genuine empty functions or disassembly artifacts (data/padding misidentified as code) is unconfirmed; the corrupted 0x004C4BA8 region is explicitly flagged by the decompiler.
